synthesis.surviving_label: H1 confirmed (ree_core commit-latch wiring gap); H2 refuted (readout is faithful)
synthesis.text: H1 (ree_core wiring defect) CONFIRMED via direct instrumentation; H2 (readout artifact) REFUTED (0/160 mismatches between the experiment's read function and ground-truth attribute reads). Root cause: agent.py's between-E3-tick stepping branch never consults the SD-084 persistent trajectory handle (unlike the MECH-321 hook, which already does), so _committed_step_idx never advances past its first post-commit value; compounded by E3 unconditionally re-deliberating and re-committing a fresh trajectory object on every E3 tick with no already-committed short-circuit. Fix is two-part (agent.py fallback + arc071_chunking.py baseline flag) plus one open, undiagnosed question (should E3 skip re-selection when already committed) -- routed to /implement-substrate (substrate_queue.json arc071_chunk_commit_latch_persistence, diagnosis_correction field) rather than applied this session, because ree_core/agent.py was under an active claim by a concurrent session's merge at diagnosis time.

hypotheses.label: H1: commit-latch wiring defect
hypotheses.desc: The step-index advance / re-deliberation suppression in select_action does not hold across ticks under train_mode=False + use_chunk_proposal_injection=True + a continued StepHarness run; a genuinely new commitment is issued every tick.
hypotheses.basis: Direct instrumentation (seeds 101/505, A_HIER_S2, forced guaranteed-selectable 3-step chunk + forced commit) shows agent._committed_step_idx never advances past 1 across 80 ticks / 8-10 E3 re-deliberation cycles per seed, and a BRAND NEW trajectory object (distinct id()) is installed on every single E3 tick despite the identical candidate being re-selected -- confirming the commit-latch does not hold across ticks in this configuration. Root cause: agent.py's between-E3-tick stepping branch never falls back to e3._persistent_committed_trajectory (unlike the MECH-321 hook), so the step-index-advance increment is never reached; compounded by no re-selection short-circuit on E3 ticks. control_passed: true (the forced-commit / guaranteed-candidate manipulation check unambiguously isolates the mechanism); non_degenerate: true (160 real ticks exercised, 18 real E3 re-deliberation cycles observed). met_elimination_bar left false -- this maps to 'supports', not an elimination target; see evidence/planning/diagnostic_arc071_commit_latch_h1h2_probe_2026-07-31.md for the full trace.

That is refuted. V3-EXQ-925's committed_fraction=0.000 was a DRIVER INSTRUMENTATION DEFECT, not a regime: its driver never called post_action_update, so E3._running_variance stayed pinned at precision_init=0.5 against commit_threshold=0.4 and commitment was arithmetically impossible before the run collected any data. The original parenthetical attributing the regime to use_gap_scaled_commit_temperature=False is likewise withdrawn: both of that flag's call sites sit inside 'elif committed:', so it cannot influence WHETHER commitment engages. SURVIVING half, re-attributed: normalised selection entropy is near-uniform at 0.998 -- independently re-measured at 0.998 by V3-EXQ-925a under a RESTORED committed regime (committed_fraction 1.0, deterministic argmin, c0 match 1.0), so the near-flatness is real and is NOT an artefact of the defect. It is re-attributed from 'no committed regime' to ABSOLUTE SCORE SCALE (H5). Under the corrected harness, F-lesion/scramble do flip the committed winner on 9.7-30% of events -- real argmin-level F authority -- but chance-directionally (frac_toward_safer 0.530/0.484), so there is no consistent safety-axis alignment and the H1-H4 discrimination remains OPEN. hypotheses.basis: Directly measured: committed_fraction=0.000 (exact), selection_entropy_normalised_mean=0.99820, replay reconstruction validated to 7.87e-09 vs the selector's own recorded distribution (so the near-uniform reading is not a replay-arithmetic artifact), degeneracy check passed (non_degenerate=true). hypotheses.label: uncontrolled score scale (new, discovered)
hypotheses.desc: Neither pre-registered hypothesis nor H0: E3's apparent F-authority is an artefact of an UNCONTROLLED ABSOLUTE SCALE in the score sum, not of any channel's causal role. F (compute_reality_cost) is the SQUARED z_world step norm over the E2 imagination rollout, while every modulatory channel is at most linear in latent scale, so var(F) ~ var(non-F)^2 -- measured on V3-EXQ-936's own 8 cells, OLS slope 2.020 (R^2 0.978) over 54 orders of magnitude, against a predicted 2.000. The rollout is unbounded by default (e2_rollout_output_norm_clamp_enabled=False), so the same substrate can sit at either extreme: V3-EXQ-925 measured a regime so FLAT that no channel steers anything (normalised entropy 0.998, committed_fraction 0.000 -- that is H0), while V3-EXQ-936 measured one so STEEP that std(non-F)/std(F) falls below float32 eps in 7 of 8 cells and the entire modulatory stack is ADDITIVELY ANNIHILATED in the score sum. Under H5, 'F's variance share' is not a stable architectural property at all, and MECH-439's own stated remedy ('rebalance F's variance share') is unreachable by re-weighting any channel -- a 1e20 magnitude gap cannot be offset by a coefficient. DISTINCT FROM H0: H0 says no channel has meaningful ABSOLUTE authority at the small-scale end; H5 says the scale itself is uncontrolled in BOTH directions and is what determines apparent authority.
hypotheses.basis: Established by arithmetic on the run's own recorded per-cell variances, needing no external control: OLS of log10 var(F) on log10 var(non-F) across all 8 cells gives slope 2.020, R^2 0.978 (OFF arm alone 1.951; DEMOTION arm alone 2.149) against the quadratic-vs-linear prediction of 2.000; and std(non-F)/std(F) sits below float32 eps (1.192e-07) in 7 of 8 cells, down to 4.6e-23. The run's OWN P3 non-degeneracy precondition is the passing control that makes this a magnitude effect rather than dead channels: the modulatory components DO carry variance (worst cell 1394.44 absolute, threshold 1e-9), so their absence from the committed score is purely relative scale. criteria_non_degenerate true for both C1 and C2. Not a rival considered when H1-H4 were framed (2026-08-12) nor when H0 was added: all five concern which channel has authority, or whether any does at this scale -- none anticipated that the scale is itself an uncontrolled free variable spanning 54 orders of magnitude across seeds of one run. It was surfaced only by V3-EXQ-936's variance decomposition, the first instrumentation in this lineage to record the component magnitudes rather than a rank statistic. NOTE what this does NOT establish: that the missing SD-056 rollout-norm clamp is the CAUSE. That is the V3-EXQ-936a A/B and has not been run.
